Strategy: Apply the gentle fifteen sweet band only for items of size thirty or more, keeping the mid penalty always on. Large items benefit most from preserved middle residuals, but the gate may rarely engage and the threshold is a guess.
```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-(r - item) + (15 if item >= 30 and r - item >= 30 and r - item <= 45 else 0) - (15 if r - item >= 8 and r - item <= 22 else 0) for r in bins]
```
